format: html

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(wooldridge)
library(flextable)
```

```{r}
# CODE
# Setting the seed
set.seed(3)
ideal_tib <- tibble(
  # Generating a sequence of 
  # integers from 1 to 10
  i = 1:10,
  # Generating 10 random numbers between 
  # 4 and 10, rounding to 2 decimal places
  y1i = round(
    x = runif(n = 10, min = 4, max = 10),
    digits = 2
    ),
  # 10 random numbers
  y0i = round(
    x = runif(n = 10, min = 0, max = 5),
    digits = 2
    ),
  diff = y1i - y0i
  ) 
```

```{r}
ideal_tib %>%
  flextable() |> autofit() |> 
  theme_booktabs() |> fontsize(size = 12) |> 
  line_spacing(space = 0.3)
```

```{r}
mean(ideal_tib$diff)
```

Gjort vha. pipe

```{r}
ideal_tib |> 
  summarise(
    round(
      x = mean(diff), 
      digits = 3
      )
  ) |> 
  pull()
```
